title: orthoraphium coreanum var. kengii
intro: Orthoraphium coreanum var. kengii, commonly known as Korean angelica tree or Chinese angelica tree, is a species of plant in the family Apiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever, relieving rheumatism, and aiding in digestion. The health benefits of Orthoraphium coreanum var. kengii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties.
